input_law: all 42 nonidentity E(F47) points, sorted by (x,y); no scalar labels read by selector
enumeration_order: increasing H=max(abs(a),b), then increasing b and a; b>=1, gcd(abs(a),b)=1, x=a/b^2
target_filter: for public target (xt,yt), generate only a congruent to xt*b^2 mod47; test the integral curve discriminant and both y roots, stop on the first reduction equal to (xt,yt)
work: record b-loop steps, residue candidate pairs, coprime discriminant tests, rational point roots inspected, success height and exact lift or height_cap_exhausted
claim_boundary: exact finite-law target-conditioned search for one curve and cap; does not imply coverage or speed for other curves or heights
